summary_text: Talen Energy reported Q1 2026 (May 5, 2026): Revenue $1.13B vs $1.05B FactSet estimate, Adjusted EBITDA $473M, Adjusted FCF $350M. Reaffirmed 2026 guidance. Repurchased 300,000 shares for $100M; $1.9B authorization remaining through 2028. Cornerstone Acquisition financing secured in April; pending close expected to drive material FCF/share uplift through 2027-2028. Stock +3.35% on the print.
